profileLabel: Center-left economics; liberal-leaning social values; institution-supporting (low-medium confidence)
summary: Manila 4th District representative with 62 principal-authored bills. Authored adolescent protection and support for adolescent parents, monthly maintenance medicine for seniors, a disease prevention and control center, regulation of unhealthy food marketing to children and an anti-dynasty ban. Co-authored free period products in schools, regulation of online gig platform workers and full disclosure of transactions.
caveat: Social and institutions scores rest partly on co-authored bills; thin.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored free monthly maintenance medication for seniors (-3) and food marketing regulation for children (-2); co-authored regulation of online gig platform workers (-2).

social.label: Liberal
social.rationale: Authored protecting adolescents and supporting adolescent parents (+3, reproductive health); co-authored free period products in schools (+2, gender). Two issues.
